entries.source: Build Seedance video prompts with a storyboard template and camera movement dictionary. Learn how to describe shot types, action, lighting and transitions.

entries.source: Seedance 2.0 Prompt Templates & Camera Movement Guide
entries.translation: Seedance 2.0 提示词模板与运镜指南

entries.source: Have you ever experienced this: when you type 'a girl walking down the street,' the generated video ends up with no camera movement, stiff characters, awkward transitions, and looks like a pixelated PowerPoint presentation?
entries.translation: 你是否遇到过这种情况：输入“a girl walking down the street”，生成的视频却没有运镜，人物僵硬、转场生涩，看起来像低清晰度的 PowerPoint 演示？

entries.source: The problem isn't the tools themselves, but your prompt lacks' structure 'and' camera movement. 'Structure determines whether a video is watchable, while camera movement dictates its visual appeal. Today, we'll tackle both core issues at once
entries.translation: 问题往往不在工具本身，而在提示词缺少“结构”和“运镜”。结构决定视频是否耐看，运镜决定视觉表现。今天我们一起解决这两个核心问题

entries.source: novice creators can apply these principles directly to produce professional-quality videos!
entries.translation: 新手也能直接运用这些原则，制作更有专业感的视频！

entries.source: Why do handwritten prompts always backfire?
entries.translation: 为什么随手写的提示词总是适得其反？

entries.source: Most people's AI video creation logic follows this pattern: blurry footage
entries.translation: 多数人的 AI 视频创作逻辑是：模糊的画面构想
自然语言描述

entries.source: AI attempts to interpret the content, only to fail nine times out of ten. The root cause lies in not specifying key elements like camera movement types, shot transitions, lighting effects, and rhythm-based visual effects to the AI.
entries.translation: AI 尝试理解，却十有八九无法达到预期。根源在于没有向 AI 明确说明运镜类型、镜头切换、光效和节奏相关的视觉效果。

entries.source: Industry veteran @yanhua1010 put it bluntly: 70% of AI video quality depends on camera movement descriptions rather than scene descriptions.
entries.translation: 行业创作者 @yanhua1010 直言：AI 视频质量的 70% 取决于运镜描述，而不是场景描述。

entries.source: Just compare to see the difference:
entries.translation: 对比一下就能看出差别：

entries.source: Standard description: A girl walking in the forest.
entries.translation: 普通描述：A girl walking in the forest.

entries.source: Professional description: A girl walking in the forest, Smooth Dolly Follow, golden hour lighting.
entries.translation: 专业描述：A girl walking in the forest, Smooth Dolly Follow, golden hour lighting.

entries.source: One is surveillance, the other is cinema
entries.translation: 一个像监控画面，一个像电影

entries.source: the difference lies in camera movement!
entries.translation: 区别就在运镜！

entries.source: Layer 1: Universal structural template for seamless implementation from scratch to full-scale deployment
entries.translation: 第一层：从零开始即可套用的通用结构模板

entries.source: User @leslieyu0 has released a storyboard-style prompt template that locks all video elements in place
entries.translation: 用户 @leslieyu0 发布了一套分镜式提示词模板，把视频各要素固定下来
复制后即可使用：

entries.source: (Multi-shot sequences for dynamic character portrayal/high-impact action sequences with seamless shot transitions) [@Material 1] Serving as the primary reference frame, [Character Name] represents the protagonist.
entries.translation: (Multi-shot sequences for dynamic character portrayal/high-impact action sequences with seamless shot transitions) [@Material 1] Serving as the primary reference frame, [Character Name] represents the protagonist.

entries.source: Shot 1 ([Shot Type]): The character appears in [Scene], performs [Core Action], and is accompanied by [Local Effects]; Shot 2 ([Shot Type]): Smooth transition between shots, focusing on facial expressions to intensify emotions; Shot 3 (Optional): Briefly highlights supporting elements to reinforce the core action.
entries.translation: Shot 1 ([Shot Type]): The character appears in [Scene], performs [Core Action], and is accompanied by [Local Effects]; Shot 2 ([Shot Type]): Smooth transition between shots, focusing on facial expressions to intensify emotions; Shot 3 (Optional): Briefly highlights supporting elements to reinforce the core action.

entries.source: Includes overall [art style], color [lighting], and built-in [sound effects/music]. Duration: 5s.
entries.translation: Includes overall [art style], color [lighting], and built-in [sound effects/music]. Duration: 5s.

entries.source: Not sure how to write the terms? Just throw the template to ChatGPT or Kimi, specify the style, main character, and atmosphere, and the AI will automatically fill in technical terms like "rapid push-pull", "photon particle flow", and "fault transition".
entries.translation: 不知道术语怎么写？把模板交给 ChatGPT 或 Kimi，说明风格、主角与氛围，让 AI 补全“快速推拉”“光子粒子流”“断层转场”等技术描述。
第二层：运镜词典

entries.source: The most critical slot for template completion
entries.translation: 填写模板时最关键的一项

entries.source: In the 'Camera Type' field of templates, 90% of users get it wrong. Here's a must-know three-level camera movement library for beginners.
entries.translation: 模板中的“镜头类型”一栏，90% 的用户容易写错。以下是新手必须掌握的三层运镜词库。

entries.source: 1. Three fundamental terms (the foundation of all camera movements)
entries.translation: 1. 三个基础术语：一切运镜的基础

entries.source: Pan (tilt): The camera position remains fixed while the lens rotates, ideal for displaying panoramic environments.
entries.translation: Pan / Tilt（摇镜头）：机位保持不动，镜头水平或垂直转动，适合展示环境全貌。

entries.source: Zoom: Adjust focal length to enlarge or reduce the subject and focus on details
entries.translation: Zoom（变焦）：调整焦距，放大或缩小主体，突出细节。

entries.source: Dolly (track): Physically moves the camera to follow the subject, creating an immersive experience.
entries.translation: Dolly（移动镜头）：实际移动机位，跟随主体，形成身临其境的感觉。

entries.source: Important note: Pan refers to 'staying still while turning your head,' whereas Dolly means 'following the movement with your entire body.' Mixing them up will definitely lead to confusion.
entries.translation: 注意：Pan 是“站着不动转头”，Dolly 是“整个人跟着移动”。混用这些词会让指令含混。

entries.source: 2. Add modifiers, directly exceeding 80% of people
entries.translation: 2. 加上修饰词，让表现更进一步

entries.source: The core vocabulary is deliberately crafted with deliberate stiffness, instantly evoking cinematic imagery:
entries.translation: 在基础词汇上加上明确修饰，马上建立电影画面感：
速度：Smooth（平滑）、Slow（缓慢）、Fast（快速）、Subtle（轻微）
情绪：Cinematic（电影感、通用）、Dreamy（梦幻）、Aggressive（强烈）、Intimate（亲密）
风格：Handheld（手持）、Aerial（航拍）、Dutch Angle（倾斜构图）

entries.source: Example combinations: Smooth Dolly Forward, Slow Aerial Pan, Cinematic Handheld Tracking
entries.translation: 组合示例：Smooth Dolly Forward、Slow Aerial Pan、Cinematic Handheld Tracking
3. 组合运镜：适配 Seedance 2.0

entries.source: Single shots work fine, but combining shots makes them look perfect. However, you can only add up to 2 shots per video
entries.translation: 单一运镜已经可用，组合运镜能让画面更完整。但每段视频最多安排两种运镜

entries.source: too many shots will just create chaos.
entries.translation: 过多指令只会让画面混乱。

entries.source: Orbit + Zoom In: Ideal for character introductions and product showcases
entries.translation: Orbit + Zoom In（环绕＋推近）：适合人物登场与产品展示。
Crane Up + Pan（升降＋摇镜头）：适合营造氛围的开场或结尾。
Dolly Zoom（滑动变焦）：希区柯克式眩晕效果。

entries.source: Tracking + Handheld Shake: Action, Chase Scenes
entries.translation: Tracking + Handheld Shake（跟拍＋手持晃动）：适合动作与追逐场景。

entries.source: Seedance 2.0 closed-eye formula: Subject + Movement + Scene + Lighting + Lens Language + Style + Image Quality + Constraints
entries.translation: Seedance 2.0 通用公式：主体＋动作＋场景＋光线＋镜头语言＋风格＋画质＋约束

entries.source: A young woman strolls through the forest, her hair gently swaying in the breeze. Her natural smile is captured in the warm light, framed by a medium shot. The camera slowly pans, delivering a smooth and steady 4K HD shot with cinematic clarity. Her face remains perfectly defined without distortion, and her body is rendered with natural proportions and rich detail.
entries.translation: A young woman strolls through the forest, her hair gently swaying in the breeze. Her natural smile is captured in the warm light, framed by a medium shot. The camera slowly pans, delivering a smooth and steady 4K HD shot with cinematic clarity. Her face remains perfectly defined without distortion, and her body is rendered with natural proportions and rich detail.

entries.source: As the sun sets over the sea, waves gently lap at the shore. The camera slowly pans across the scene, bathed in warm orange tones that evoke healing serenity. The image flows smoothly in 4K ultra-HD resolution, free from flickering or ghosting.

entries.source: Maintaining character appearance and clothing consistency through reference frames, with slow hand-raising and turning motions that appear natural and fluid without stiffness or distortion. The camera movement remains stable, featuring high-definition details and cinematic quality.
entries.translation: Maintaining character appearance and clothing consistency through reference frames, with slow hand-raising and turning motions that appear natural and fluid without stiffness or distortion. The camera movement remains stable, featuring high-definition details and cinematic quality.
5 条避坑规则：来自反复实践

entries.source: Write actions slowly and in sequence: Avoid using "dancing" and instead describe "slowly turning around and gently raising the hand".
entries.translation: 动作写得缓慢、有顺序：不要只写“跳舞”，而应描述“缓缓转身，轻轻抬手”。
运镜保持稳定、简单：
每段视频最多两种运镜组合

entries.source: Add stabilization constraints: Ensure smooth and stable video playback with no jitter or flicker
entries.translation: 增加稳定约束：画面流畅稳定，不抖动、不闪烁。

entries.source: Required character constraints: The video must meet the following criteria: stable facial expression without distortion, clear facial features, and consistent clothing.
entries.translation: 人物约束必不可少：表情稳定、不变形，五官清晰，服装保持一致。

entries.source: Replace vague terms with precise ones: move
entries.translation: 用精确描述替代模糊词：移动
平滑地向前移动镜头 3 秒；漂亮
治愈、清新、温暖的光线

entries.translation: 上传参考图，粘贴提示词，并检查 @image 引用。

entries.source: Set aspect ratio to 16:9 and duration to 5 seconds. Click to generate.
entries.translation: 将画面比例设为 16:9，时长设为 5 秒，点击生成。

entries.source: Bean bag restriction: Direct upload of real photos is not supported. Real images must undergo avatar face verification.
entries.translation: 豆包的限制：不支持直接上传真人照片；真人图像需要通过数字分身人脸验证。
最后想说

entries.source: This template ensures structural integrity, smooth camera movements, stable visuals, and character fidelity, outperforming over 80% of creators effortlessly.
entries.translation: 这套模板兼顾结构、顺畅运镜、画面稳定和人物一致性，可以帮助你超过文章所述的 80% 创作者。

entries.source: However, when scores exceed 80 points, the competition shifts from the accuracy of prompts to your mastery of visual storytelling, pacing, and narrative techniques. Tools will become increasingly prevalent, templates more accessible, but ultimately, what truly resonates with people remains the story you choose to tell.
entries.translation: 但超过 80 分以后，竞争重点会从提示词是否准确，转向你对视觉叙事、节奏和故事技巧的掌握。工具会越来越普及，模板会越来越容易获得，最终打动人的仍然是你选择讲述的故事。

entries.source: How to Use Seedance for Free in 2026 (All Free Methods) | SEEDANCE Blog

entries.source: Hey there! If you’re eager to try Seedance 2.0—the viral AI video generator from ByteDance—but don’t want to spend a dime, you’re in the right place. No fancy tricks, no hidden fees—just simple, working methods to use Seedance for free in 2026.
entries.translation: 如果你想试试字节跳动广受关注的 AI 视频生成器 Seedance 2.0，又不想花钱，这篇文章就是为你准备的。原文介绍了 2026 年免费使用 Seedance 的简单方法，无需复杂技巧或隐藏费用。

entries.source: Let’s cut to the chase. These are the only free ways you need, tested and confirmed to work this year.
entries.translation: 直接进入正题。以下是原文称已在本年测试确认的免费方法。

entries.source: 1. Start with Dreamina’s Free Plan (No Credit Card Needed)
entries.translation: 1. 从 Dreamina 免费方案开始：无需信用卡

entries.source: The easiest way to use Seedance 2.0 for free is through Dreamina, ByteDance’s official AI creation platform. Just sign up for a free account—no credit card required—and you’ll get a daily free quota that resets every 24 hours.
entries.translation: 免费使用 Seedance 2.0 的便捷途径是字节跳动官方 AI 创作平台 Dreamina。注册免费账号即可，无需信用卡，可获得每 24 小时重置的每日免费额度。

entries.source: What you get: Full access to Seedance 2.0 (not a demo), 1080p output, and enough quota for 2–3 short 5-second videos per day. Perfect for testing ideas, making quick social media clips, or just playing around with its multi-modal features (text, image to video).
entries.translation: 原文列出的内容：完整 Seedance 2.0 使用权限、1080p 输出，以及每天约 2–3 段 5 秒短视频的额度。适合验证创意、快速制作社交片段，或尝试文字和图像生成视频等多模态功能。

entries.source: 2. Free BytePlus API Token (For Developers & Power Users)
entries.translation: 2. 免费 BytePlus API Token：面向开发者与进阶用户

entries.source: If you’re a developer or want more flexibility, sign up for BytePlus ModelArk API. New accounts get 2 million free tokens—no expiration date—to use Seedance 2.0’s API (both Lite and Pro versions).
entries.translation: 如果你是开发者或希望更灵活地使用，可以注册 BytePlus ModelArk API。原文称新账号可获得无到期日的 200 万免费 token，用于 Seedance 2.0 API 的 Lite 和 Pro 版本。

entries.source: That’s more than enough to test integrations, build prototypes, or generate hundreds of short videos without paying. No strings attached—use the tokens at your own pace.
entries.translation: 这些额度可用于测试集成、制作原型，或生成大量短视频。按照自己的节奏使用即可。
3. 提供免费额度的第三方平台

entries.source: Several third-party sites that use Seedance 2.0 offer free daily quotas, so you don’t even need a ByteDance account. Try SoraVideo.art or Seedance2AI.one—both let you use Seedance for free, no credit card, with 1080p to 2K output options.
entries.translation: 一些使用 Seedance 2.0 的第三方网站提供每日免费额度，无需字节跳动账号。原文推荐 SoraVideo.art 和 Seedance2AI.one，并称它们无需信用卡，提供 1080p 到 2K 输出选项。

entries.source: Quick Tips to Maximize Free Use
entries.translation: 充分利用免费额度的小技巧

entries.source: • Test with 4–5 second videos first to save quota (no need to waste free credits on long clips).

entries.translation: • 如果只需验证创意，可使用 Seedance 1.0 Lite：速度更快，消耗额度更少。

entries.source: Wrap-up: You don’t need to pay to use Seedance in 2026. Start with Dreamina for casual use, BytePlus API for more control, or third-party sites for quick access. All work, all free.
entries.translation: 总结：原文认为 2026 年可以免费使用 Seedance。轻度使用从 Dreamina 开始；需要更多控制可用 BytePlus API；想快速尝试可选第三方网站。

entries.source: How to Use the Seedance API: Complete Developer Guide 2026 | SEEDANCE Blog
entries.translation: 如何使用 Seedance API：2026 年完整开发者指南 | SEEDANCE 博客

entries.source: If you want to build AI video features into your app in 2026, Seedance is one of the APIs worth looking at. The current Seedance documentation on Volcengine Ark shows a full video-generation workflow with API key setup, authentication, file upload support, task creation, task lookup, pricing pages, and official tutorials for developers.
entries.translation: 如果你想在 2026 年为应用加入 AI 视频功能，Seedance 是值得了解的 API 之一。火山引擎方舟中的 Seedance 文档展示了完整视频生成流程，包括 API 密钥设置、身份验证、文件上传、任务创建、任务查询、价格页面和开发者官方教程。

entries.source: The good news is that the integration model is straightforward. Seedance uses an asynchronous task flow: you send a request to create a video generation job, get back a task ID, and then query that task until the output is ready. The same docs also expose a Files API, which matters if you want to pass reference images, audio, or video instead of relying on text prompts alone.
entries.translation: 集成方式比较直接。Seedance 使用异步任务流程：发送请求创建视频任务，获得任务 ID，再查询任务直到输出完成。文档也提供 Files API，适用于上传图像、音频或视频参考，而非只使用文字提示词。
什么是 Seedance API？

entries.source: Seedance is a video-generation model family available through Volcengine Ark. Official model and release pages indicate that newer Seedance releases support multimodal reference inputs such as images, video, and audio, and also include capabilities like video editing and extension. That makes it useful for more than simple text-to-video demos.
entries.translation: Seedance 是通过火山引擎方舟提供的视频生成模型系列。官方模型和发布页面说明，新版本支持图像、视频、音频等多模态参考输入，并包含视频编辑与延长能力，因此用途不限于简单的文生视频演示。

entries.translation: 实际使用中，Seedance API 适合以下产品：
AI 视频生成器
广告创意工具
分镜应用
数字人或有声媒体工作流程
内部内容制作工具

entries.source: Prompt quality matters more than most teams expect. Volcengine currently publishes Seedance prompt guides and video-generation tutorials alongside the API docs, which is a sign that output quality depends heavily on how you structure your instructions.
entries.translation: 提示词质量往往比团队预期更重要。火山引擎同时提供 Seedance 提示词指南、视频生成教程和 API 文档，说明输出质量高度依赖指令结构。

应避免的常见错误

entries.source: The most common Seedance API mistakes are boring, not exotic.
entries.translation: 常见的 Seedance API 错误多半很基础。

entries.source: The first is treating video generation like a synchronous endpoint. It is not. The documented workflow is task-based, so your code should be written around polling, retries, and status handling.
entries.translation: 第一，把视频生成当成同步接口。文档规定的是任务流程，代码需要围绕轮询、重试和状态处理来设计。

entries.source: The second is skipping cost checks. Seedance pricing is maintained on a separate model pricing page, and video-generation costs can change by model tier. Always verify the model you plan to ship with.
entries.translation: 第二，跳过成本检查。Seedance 的价格在独立模型价格页面维护，不同模型档位的生成成本可能变化，务必核实准备上线的模型。

entries.source: The third is writing overloaded prompts. If your prompt asks for too many incompatible camera moves, styles, and scene changes at once, output quality usually drops.
entries.translation: 第三，提示词过于拥挤。如果同时要求太多互相矛盾的运镜、风格和场景变化，输出质量通常会下降。

entries.source: The fourth is re-uploading the same source assets for every job instead of designing around reusable file references.
entries.translation: 第四，每次任务都重新上传相同素材，而不是使用可复用的文件引用。
生产使用的最佳实践

entries.translation: 把 Seedance 集成到真实产品时，保持架构简单：

entries.translation: 在数据库中保存任务 ID

entries.source: separate upload logic from generation logic

entries.source: Seedance is ByteDance's AI video generator, and its pricing is more fragmented than most tools — because access runs through multiple platforms, each with its own credit system and cost structure. This guide cuts through the noise and tells you exactly what you'll pay and which option makes sense for your workflow.
entries.translation: Seedance 是字节跳动的 AI 视频生成器，价格结构比许多工具更分散，因为它通过多个平台提供，每个平台都有自己的积分体系和成本结构。本指南帮你理清费用，并选择适合工作流程的选项。
简要答案

entries.source: You can use Seedance today for free. If you need more output, paid options start at roughly $9.60/month through Dreamina (ByteDance's international platform) — about 20 times cheaper than Sora 2 Pro. For developers, the BytePlus API charges per second of video generated.
entries.translation: 现在可以免费使用 Seedance。如果需要更多输出，Dreamina（字节跳动国际平台）的付费方案约从 $9.60/月起，约比 Sora 2 Pro 便宜 20 倍。开发者可使用按生成视频秒数计费的 BytePlus API。

entries.source: Free Tiers: What You Actually Get
entries.translation: 免费档位实际提供什么
Dreamina

entries.source: is the most accessible free option for international users. You get daily credits that reset every 24 hours — enough for roughly 2–3 standard video clips per day. No credit card required, no time limit. The catch: accessing Seedance 2.0 specifically requires a 1 RMB (~$0.14) trial unlock, so it's not entirely frictionless.
entries.translation: 是国际用户最容易使用的免费选项。每日积分每 24 小时重置，大致可生成 2–3 个标准片段，无需信用卡或限时试用。不过，使用 Seedance 2.0 需要支付 1 元人民币（约 $0.14）解锁试用，因此仍有一定门槛。
小云雀

entries.source: (ByteDance's Chinese-market app) is the most generous free tier — 1,200 credits on signup plus 120 daily credits, which works out to about 2 short videos per day indefinitely. The barrier: it requires a Chinese (+86) phone number and the interface is Chinese-only.
entries.translation: 是字节跳动面向中国市场的应用，免费档位额度较多：注册获得 1,200 积分，每日再获 120 积分，约可长期每天生成两段短视频。使用门槛是需要中国大陆（+86）手机号，且界面仅提供中文。
豆包

entries.source: offers 10 free generations per day but requires Feishu beta access and is also Chinese-only.
entries.translation: 每天提供 10 次免费生成，但需要飞书测试资格，界面也仅提供中文。
BytePlus API

entries.source: gives developers 2 million free tokens on signup — enough to prototype a full application before spending anything.
entries.translation: 注册时为开发者提供 200 万免费 token，足以在付费前为完整应用制作原型。

Seedance 价格表截图
真正影响成本的因素

entries.source: The credit cost per video isn't fixed — it depends on four variables that stack on top of each other.
entries.translation: 每个视频的积分费用并不固定，而是由四个相互叠加的变量决定。

entries.source: is the most obvious multiplier. A 6-second clip costs roughly half what a 12-second clip does, so always start short when testing a new prompt or motion style.
entries.translation: 是最明显的倍率因素。6 秒片段的费用约为 12 秒的一半，因此测试新提示词或动作风格时始终从短片段开始。
分辨率

entries.source: is where costs jump unexpectedly. Moving from 720p to 1080p roughly doubles credit consumption. Moving to 2K can cost 2–3x the standard rate. Reserve high resolution for final exports, not drafts.
entries.translation: 可能让成本意外上涨。从 720p 升到 1080p，积分消耗约翻倍；升到 2K 可能是标准费用的 2–3 倍。高分辨率应留给最终导出，而不是草稿。
音频生成

entries.source: doubles the credit cost per video. If you're adding music or voiceover in post-production anyway, disable audio generation entirely — it's the easiest cost to cut.
entries.translation: 会让单个视频的积分费用翻倍。如果本来就准备在后期加入音乐或配音，可关闭音频生成，这是最容易削减的成本。
重试

entries.source: are the silent budget killer. Each failed or unsatisfactory generation burns full credits. A practical rule: cap yourself at two draft attempts and one final pass. If you're still not happy, the problem is usually the prompt, not the model.
entries.translation: 会悄悄消耗预算。每次失败或不满意的生成都会消耗完整积分。实用规则是最多两次草稿和一次最终生成；仍不满意时，问题往往出在提示词而不是模型。

entries.source: The official Dreamina plans are significantly cheaper, but international users sometimes run into friction — Chinese payment methods (Alipay, WeChat Pay) may be required for certain features, and the 1 RMB trial unlock can be awkward without a Chinese payment method.
entries.translation: 官方 Dreamina 方案明显更便宜，但国际用户有时会遇到门槛：部分功能可能要求支付宝或微信支付，没有中国支付方式时，1 元试用解锁也不太方便。

entries.source: Third-party platforms like seedance2.app charge roughly 4x more than Dreamina Basic, but they offer English interfaces, standard international payment processing, and no dependency on Chinese platform accounts. For individuals, that premium is hard to justify. For teams where employee time is expensive, it often makes sense.
entries.translation: seedance2.app 等第三方平台约为 Dreamina Basic 的四倍价格，但提供英文界面、常规国际支付，无需依赖中国平台账号。个人用户可能难以接受这笔溢价，而员工时间成本较高的团队可能觉得值得。
Seedance 与竞争产品的价格对比

entries.source: Seedance wins on price at every tier and is the only major model offering a genuine free option with no credit card. The trade-off is platform fragmentation and, for non-Chinese users, some access friction on the cheapest plans.
entries.translation: 文章认为 Seedance 在各档位价格上更有优势，也是主要模型中提供无需信用卡的免费选项之一。代价是平台分散，以及非中国用户在最便宜方案上的使用门槛。

entries.source: Both tools can generate strong visuals, but they differ in how creators control outputs at scale. This comparison focuses on real production behavior instead of one-off demo quality.
entries.translation: 两者都能生成优秀画面，但在创作者如何批量控制输出方面有所不同。本页聚焦真实制作行为，而非单次演示的画质。

entries.source: Comparison framework for Seedance and Kling across creative workflow metrics
entries.translation: 按创意流程指标比较 Seedance 和 Kling 的框架

entries.source: Comparison dimensions: controllability, references, short-form fit, and team iteration speed.
entries.translation: 比较维度：控制能力、参考素材、短视频适配与团队迭代速度。
提示词控制能力

entries.source: Seedance workflows emphasize multi-modal control through explicit references, making it easier to replicate campaign logic across multiple variants. Kling can deliver strong single outputs but may require different prompt phrasing to maintain consistency.
entries.translation: Seedance 流程强调通过明确参考进行多模态控制，便于在多个变体中复用广告逻辑。Kling 可以生成优秀的单次结果，但维持一致性时可能需要不同的提示词表达。
参考迁移质量

entries.source: For teams using camera references and style references together, Seedance-style mapping patterns often reduce drift. If your process depends on predictable reference reuse, this is a key decision factor.
entries.translation: 同时使用镜头参考和风格参考的团队，采用 Seedance 式的映射通常有助于减少偏离。如果流程依赖可预测的参考复用，这是关键选择因素。

entries.source: Reference transfer example in AI video generation workflows
entries.translation: AI 视频生成流程中的参考迁移示例

entries.source: Reference transfer is usually the bottleneck for repeatable campaign output.
entries.translation: 参考迁移通常是可重复广告制作的瓶颈。
短视频广告适配

entries.source: For TikTok and Reels pipelines, controllable 9:16 prompt templates matter more than cinematic one-offs. Seedance templates built around hook-first structure can improve repeatability for media testing cycles.
entries.translation: 对 TikTok 和 Reels 制作流程来说，可控的 9:16 提示词模板比单次电影效果更重要。围绕开头吸引力设计的 Seedance 模板有助于媒体测试周期的可重复性。
迭代速度与团队协作

entries.source: The winning model for teams is usually the one that supports clear iteration logs. If your team can quickly diagnose why a result changed, your creative velocity goes up. Seedance-oriented workflows are easier to standardize when everyone follows the same prompt template grammar.
entries.translation: 团队最适合的模型通常能支持清楚的迭代记录。若能快速判断结果为什么改变，创意效率就会提高。所有人遵循同一提示词模板结构时，Seedance 流程更容易标准化。

entries.source: Creative team iteration process with model output review loops
entries.translation: 创意团队使用模型输出审查循环的迭代流程

entries.source: Team operations improve when prompts and review criteria are standardized.
entries.translation: 统一提示词与审查标准，有助于改进团队协作。
选择建议

entries.source: Choose based on workflow objective: if you need strict repeatability and reference-driven production, Seedance-style pipelines are often stronger. If your priority is exploratory ideation with fewer operational constraints, compare both on your own benchmark prompts before committing.
entries.translation: 根据工作流程目标选择：需要严格复用和参考驱动制作时，Seedance 式流程往往更合适；若更重视探索性构思、操作限制较少，请先用自己的基准提示词比较两者。

entries.source: Seedance 2.0 works best when you treat video generation as a workflow, not a one-shot prompt.
entries.translation: 把视频生成视为完整工作流程，而不是一次性的提示词，才能更好地使用 Seedance 2.0。

entries.source: A good result usually comes from four things:
entries.translation: 良好结果通常来自四点：

entries.source: clear reference assets, a structured prompt, controlled motion, and focused iteration
entries.translation: 清晰参考素材、结构化提示词、可控动作与有重点的迭代

entries.source: This tutorial walks through a practical Seedance 2.0 workflow from the first reference image to the final video.
entries.translation: 本教程介绍从第一张参考图到最终视频的实用 Seedance 2.0 流程。
1. 先准备参考素材

entries.source: Before writing the prompt, decide what you want Seedance to follow.
entries.translation: 编写提示词之前，先确定希望 Seedance 遵循什么。
简单配置可以是：
@image1

entries.source: — main character, product, object, or visual style
entries.translation: — 主要人物、产品、物体或视觉风格
@video1

entries.source: — motion, camera movement, or action reference
entries.translation: — 动作、运镜或行为参考
@audio1

entries.source: — optional rhythm, dialogue, or sound reference
entries.translation: — 可选的节奏、对白或声音参考

entries.source: You do not need to use every type of reference in every generation. Start with the assets that actually affect the shot.
entries.translation: 并非每次生成都需要所有类型的参考。先使用真正影响镜头的素材。

entries.source: For example, if character appearance matters most, use a strong character image. If the camera movement is difficult to describe, add a video reference.
entries.translation: 例如，人物外观最重要时使用清晰人物图；运镜难以描述时，再加入视频参考。
需要不同的参考角度？

entries.source: Sometimes you only have one image of a product, prop, or stylized object, but the video needs to show it from another angle.
entries.translation: 有时你只有产品、道具或风格化物体的一张图，但视频需要从另一个角度展示。
一种实用流程是：

entries.source: Reference Image → 3D Model → Choose a New Angle → Render a Still Image → Seedance
entries.translation: 参考图 → 3D 模型 → 选择新角度 → 渲染静态图 → Seedance
可以使用

entries.source: to turn a clear object image into a 3D model, rotate the model to the angle you need, and create a new still reference. Then upload that image to Seedance as your visual anchor.
entries.translation: 将清晰的物体图片转换为 3D 模型，旋转到需要的角度并制作新的静态参考，再上传到 Seedance 作为视觉锚点。

产品镜头
道具
车辆
家具
风格化物体

entries.source: It gives you more control over the reference angle before video generation begins.
entries.translation: 这样可以在视频生成开始前，更精确地控制参考角度。

entries.source: 2. Write the Prompt in Three Parts
entries.translation: 2. 将提示词分为三部分

entries.source: A Seedance prompt does not need to be long. It needs to be clear.
entries.translation: Seedance 提示词无需很长，但必须清楚。
实用结构是：

entries.source: Subject and action + visual style + camera and motion
entries.translation: 主体与动作＋视觉风格＋镜头与运动

entries.source: The important part is that each sentence has a job.
entries.translation: 关键是让每句话承担明确任务。
主体与动作
描述发生什么：
视觉风格

entries.source: Describe how the scene should look:
entries.translation: 描述场景应呈现什么样貌：

entries.source: Describe how the viewer sees it:
entries.translation: 描述观众如何看到场景：

entries.source: Combining the three gives Seedance much clearer direction than stacking unrelated adjectives.
entries.translation: 组合这三部分，比堆叠互不相关的形容词能给 Seedance 更清晰的指令。
3. 明确使用参考素材

entries.source: If you upload reference files, tell Seedance what each one is for.
entries.translation: 上传参考文件后，告诉 Seedance 每个文件的用途。

entries.source: Do not assume the model knows why you uploaded them.
entries.translation: 不要假定模型知道你为什么上传它们。

4. 具体描述动作

entries.source: For video generation, action logic matters more than decorative language.
entries.translation: 视频生成中，动作逻辑比修饰性语言更重要。
避免以下提示词：

entries.source: These words say very little about what should actually move.
entries.translation: 这些词几乎没有说明实际需要移动的内容。

entries.source: starting position → action → direction → ending position
entries.translation: 起始位置 → 动作 → 方向 → 结束位置

entries.source: This is especially useful when generating scenes with people, vehicles, camera movement, or several consecutive actions.
entries.translation: 生成人物、车辆、运镜或多个连续动作的场景时，这种方法尤其有效。
5. 单独控制镜头

entries.source: Subject movement and camera movement are different instructions.
entries.translation: 主体运动和镜头运动是不同的指令。

向上 / 下摇镜头
在主体旁边跟拍
从后方跟随
围绕主体环绕
手持运动

entries.source: If you want a stable shot, say so.
entries.translation: 想要稳定镜头时，明确说出来。

entries.source: Explicit constraints can prevent Seedance from adding unnecessary movement.
entries.translation: 明确约束可避免 Seedance 添加不必要的运动。
6. 每个镜头保持聚焦

entries.source: Trying to fit too many actions into one generation often makes the result less predictable.
entries.translation: 一次生成包含太多动作，结果往往更难预测。

entries.source: Split the sequence into several shots.
entries.translation: 把序列拆成几个镜头。
镜头 1：

entries.source: He enters the office and sits at the desk.
entries.translation: He enters the office and sits at the desk.
镜头 2：

entries.source: Close-up. He opens the laptop and notices something on screen.
entries.translation: Close-up. He opens the laptop and notices something on screen.
镜头 3：

entries.source: He quickly stands and leaves the room.
entries.translation: He quickly stands and leaves the room.

entries.source: Each shot now has a clear beginning and end.
entries.translation: 现在每个镜头都有清楚的开始与结束。

entries.source: For short-form video, this also makes editing easier.
entries.translation: 对短视频来说，也更便于剪辑。

entries.source: 7. Match the Aspect Ratio to the Final Platform
entries.translation: 7. 根据最终平台选择画面比例

entries.source: Choose your composition before generation rather than cropping everything afterward.
entries.translation: 生成前选择构图，而不是事后裁切全部内容。
竖屏短视频使用

entries.source: and keep important subjects away from the extreme top and bottom of the frame.
entries.translation: ，并让重要主体远离画面最上方和最下方。
横屏视频中，

entries.source: gives you more horizontal space for environments, multiple characters, and lateral movement.
entries.translation: 为环境、多个人物和横向运动提供更多水平空间。

entries.source: Also consider where subtitles, platform buttons, or captions may appear.
entries.translation: 还要考虑字幕、平台按钮或说明文字可能出现的位置。

entries.source: The best composition is not simply the one that looks good in the generator. It should work in the final publishing format.
entries.translation: 最佳构图不仅要在生成器中好看，还应适合最终发布格式。

entries.source: 8. Change One Thing at a Time
entries.translation: 8. 每次只改变一个变量

entries.source: When a generation is close but not correct, do not rewrite the entire prompt.
entries.translation: 生成结果接近目标但仍不正确时，不要重写整份提示词。
先找到问题。

entries.source: If the character looks correct but the camera moves too fast, change only the camera instruction.
entries.translation: 人物正确但运镜太快时，只修改镜头指令。

entries.source: If the action works but the product changes shape, strengthen the reference instruction.
entries.translation: 动作正常但产品变形时，加强参考指令。

entries.source: If the composition is right but the lighting is wrong, change only the lighting description.
entries.translation: 构图正确但光线不对时，只修改光线描述。
简单的迭代流程是：
识别最大问题
修改一条指令
再次生成
比较两个结果

entries.source: This makes it much easier to learn which instructions are actually affecting the output.
entries.translation: 这样更容易判断哪些指令真正影响了输出。
9. 导出前检查四点

entries.source: Before choosing the final generation, review:
entries.translation: 选择最终结果之前，检查：
主体一致性

entries.source: Does the character, product, or object stay visually consistent?
entries.translation: 人物、产品或物体在视觉上是否保持一致？
运动

entries.source: Do movements start and stop naturally?
entries.translation: 动作的开始和停止是否自然？

entries.source: Does the camera move in the direction and speed you requested?
entries.translation: 镜头是否按要求的方向和速度移动？
构图

entries.source: Does the important subject stay readable throughout the shot?
entries.translation: 重要主体是否始终清楚可见？

entries.source: A visually impressive generation is not necessarily usable if the subject changes halfway through or the camera loses the main action.
entries.translation: 即使画面很惊艳，如果主体中途改变或镜头丢失主要动作，结果也未必可用。
10. 建立可重复的流程

entries.source: Once you find a combination that works, keep it.
entries.translation: 找到有效组合后，保存下来。
保存：
成功的提示词
人物参考图
镜头参考片段
实用动作描述
不同画面比例版本

entries.source: failed prompts and what went wrong
entries.translation: 失败提示词及问题原因

entries.source: Over time, you will build your own prompt library.
entries.translation: 逐渐积累出自己的提示词库。
实用的 Seedance 流程是：

entries.source: Idea → Reference Assets → Prompt → Generate → Review → Change One Variable → Generate Again → Export
entries.translation: 创意 → 参考素材 → 提示词 → 生成 → 审查 → 改变一个变量 → 再次生成 → 导出

entries.source: That process is more reliable than trying to write a perfect prompt from scratch every time.
entries.translation: 这个过程比每次从零编写完美提示词更可靠。
最后的建议

entries.source: Better Seedance videos do not usually come from longer prompts.
entries.translation: 更好的 Seedance 视频通常并非来自更长的提示词，
而是来自
更好的参考和更清晰的指令

entries.source: Prepare the visual source first, describe exactly what moves, separate subject motion from camera motion, and iterate one variable at a time.
entries.translation: 先准备视觉来源，准确描述什么会移动，分开主体运动和运镜，每次只迭代一个变量。

entries.source: If the original image does not give you the angle you need, creating a new reference through a 3D workflow can also be useful before you start video generation.
entries.translation: 如果原图没有所需角度，视频生成前通过 3D 流程创建新参考图，也可能很有帮助。

entries.source: Can Seedance 2.5 turn one image into a video?
entries.translation: Seedance 2.5 能把一张图片变成视频吗？

entries.source: Yes. Use the image as the visual anchor, then prompt the desired subject motion, camera path, environment response, duration, and consistency constraints.
entries.translation: 可以。将图像作为视觉锚点，再用提示词指定主体动作、镜头路径、环境响应、时长与一致性约束。

entries.source: How long can a Seedance 2.5 video be?
entries.translation: Seedance 2.5 视频最长多久？

entries.source: The official Seedance 2.5 page lists up to 30 seconds in a single generation, with extension support. Short drafts remain the fastest way to validate a new idea.
entries.translation: Seedance 2.5 官方页面列出单次生成最多 30 秒，并支持延长。短草稿仍是验证新想法最快的方式。

entries.source: What is the best Seedance 2.5 prompt structure?
entries.translation: Seedance 2.5 的提示词应如何组织？

entries.source: Use: subject anchor, action, camera movement, timing, environment response, visual style, audio direction, and consistency constraints.
entries.translation: 使用：主体锚点、动作、运镜、时间安排、环境响应、视觉风格、音频指令与一致性约束。

entries.source: Should I use all available references?
entries.translation: 应该用上所有可用参考吗？

entries.source: No. Use only the references needed to control a specific property. Too many overlapping references can make priorities unclear.
entries.translation: 不必。只使用控制某项具体属性所需的参考。过多重叠参考会让优先级模糊。

entries.source: How to use Seedance 2.5 for image-to-video
entries.translation: 如何用 Seedance 2.5 进行图生视频
1. 选择适合制作的参考图

entries.source: Your source image establishes identity, composition, lighting, wardrobe, and object geometry. Use an image with a clearly visible subject, natural anatomy, enough space for the intended motion, and no accidental text or visual artifacts. If the face or product is already distorted in the input, motion will usually amplify the problem.
entries.translation: 来源图像建立人物身份、构图、光线、服装和物体结构。选择主体清楚、身体自然、运动空间足够，且没有多余文字或瑕疵的图像。如果输入中的脸或产品已经变形，运动通常会放大问题。

entries.source: Use a sharp image with the subject separated from the background.
entries.translation: 使用清晰图像，让主体与背景分离。

entries.source: Match the source aspect ratio to the final platform whenever possible.
entries.translation: 尽量让来源图的画面比例匹配最终平台。

entries.source: Leave visual space in the direction the subject or camera will move.
entries.translation: 在主体或镜头将移动的方向留出空间。

entries.source: Avoid asking a tight portrait to become a distant full-body shot in one step.
entries.translation: 避免要求紧凑人像一步变成远景全身镜头。
2. 确定一个视觉目标

entries.source: Decide what the clip must accomplish before writing the prompt: animate a portrait, reveal a product, establish a location, reproduce a camera move, or create a short narrative beat. One clip can contain multiple shots, but every shot should support the same objective.
entries.translation: 写提示词前，确定片段必须实现什么：让肖像动起来、揭晓产品、展示地点、复现运镜，或形成短暂叙事节点。一个片段可包含多个镜头，但每个镜头都应服务于同一目标。
3. 描述动作，而非重复图像

entries.source: The model can already see the reference. Spend prompt space on what changes over time: eye movement, hand motion, fabric response, camera path, environmental motion, sound, and the final pose. Use concrete verbs and a clear sequence.
entries.translation: 模型已经能看到参考图。把提示词用于描述随时间改变的内容：眼神、手部动作、布料反应、镜头路径、环境运动、声音与最后的姿势。使用具体动词和清楚顺序。
4. 添加运镜与时间安排

entries.source: Choose one main movement such as a slow dolly in, lateral tracking shot, controlled orbit, tilt up, or locked-off shot. For longer clips, assign actions to time ranges. Timestamp instructions help separate narrative beats and reduce contradictory motion.
entries.translation: 选择一种主要运动，例如缓慢推进、横向跟拍、可控环绕、上摇或固定镜头。较长片段按时间范围安排动作，时间戳指令有助于区分叙事节点，减少相互矛盾的运动。
5. 添加一致性约束

entries.source: State what must not change. Useful constraints include: preserve the subject's facial features, body proportions, hairstyle, clothing details, product logo placement, background layout, and lighting direction. Constraints work best when they are specific and short.
entries.translation: 说明哪些内容不得改变，例如主体五官、身体比例、发型、服装细节、产品标识位置、背景布局和光线方向。约束应简短而具体。
6. 先生成短片，评估后再延长

entries.source: Begin with a short draft to validate identity and motion. Review the first and final frames, hands, facial details, camera stability, background geometry, and audio synchronization. Fix the largest problem first. Once the motion language works, create the longer version or use extension to continue the sequence.
entries.translation: 先用短草稿验证身份与动作。检查首尾帧、手、面部细节、镜头稳定性、背景结构与音画同步，优先修正最大问题。动作描述生效后，再制作长版本或通过延长继续序列。
Seedance 2.5 提示词公式

entries.source: A reliable image-to-video prompt can be assembled in this order:
entries.translation: 可靠的图生视频提示词可按以下顺序组合：
推荐设置

entries.source: The exact controls available can vary by interface. Use these choices as production targets rather than rigid defaults.
entries.translation: 具体控件可能因界面而异。以下选项是制作目标，而非必须遵守的固定默认值。
起始选择
何时调整
草稿采用 5–10 秒

entries.source: Move toward 15–30 seconds after motion and identity are stable.
entries.translation: 动作和身份稳定后，再增加到 15–30 秒。
匹配参考图

entries.source: Use 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok, 16:9 for landscape video, or 1:1 for square placements.
entries.translation: Shorts / Reels / TikTok 使用 9:16；横屏视频使用 16:9；方形版位使用 1:1。
一种主要运镜

entries.source: Add a second move only when the transition has a clear story purpose.
entries.translation: 只有转场具有明确叙事目的时，才加入第二种运镜。
参考数量
一张高质量图片

entries.source: Add references only to control a specific character, object, location, motion, or sound.
entries.translation: 仅在需要控制特定人物、物体、地点、动作或声音时添加参考。
提示词时间安排
一个连续动作

entries.source: Use timestamp ranges for multiple shots or precise changes.
entries.translation: 多个镜头或精确变化使用时间戳范围。
变体策略
每个创意三个版本

entries.source: Change only the action, camera, or pacing in each version so results remain comparable.
entries.translation: 各版本只改变动作、镜头或节奏，让结果保持可比。
细微自然动作的人像
产品揭晓
按时间安排的电影场景
动作参考流程

entries.source: How to control references without creating conflicts
entries.translation: 如何控制参考而不制造冲突

entries.source: More references do not automatically produce a better result. Assign one job to each asset and name that job in the prompt. For example, use one image for identity, another for wardrobe, one video for motion, and one audio clip for rhythm. If two references disagree about the same feature, choose a priority explicitly.
entries.translation: 更多参考不会自动带来更好结果。为每份素材分配一项任务，并在提示词中明确用途。例如，一张图用于身份，另一张用于服装，一段视频用于动作，一段音频用于节奏。如果两份参考对同一属性有分歧，应明确优先级。

entries.source: Seedance 2.5's official documentation describes stronger control over image, video, audio, motion, creative, clay-render, and editing references. The practical advantage is not the maximum number of files—it is the ability to tell the model exactly which property to borrow from each file.
entries.translation: Seedance 2.5 官方文档介绍了对图像、视频、音频、动作、创意、泥模与编辑参考的更强控制。实际优势不在文件数量上限，而在于能准确告诉模型应从每份文件借用哪项属性。
时间戳编辑与延长

entries.source: For a longer clip, write a simple shot schedule before the full prose prompt. Give each interval one action and one camera instruction. If only one part fails, request a targeted change for that time range while preserving the rest of the sequence. For extensions, restate the character, environment, visual style, motion direction, and sound continuity that must carry forward.
entries.translation: 较长片段先写简单分镜时间表，再写完整提示词。每个区间安排一个动作和一个镜头指令。如果只有一处失败，要求在对应时间段局部修改并保留其他内容。延长时再次说明必须延续的人物、环境、风格、运动方向和声音连续性。
问题排查
脸或产品发生变化

entries.source: Reduce the size of the pose change, use a clearer reference, shorten the first draft, and repeat the exact visual details that must remain fixed. For products, identify shape, material, label position, logo, and cap separately.
entries.translation: 减少姿势变化幅度，使用更清晰参考，缩短初稿，并重复必须固定的准确细节。产品应分别说明形状、材质、标签位置、标志与瓶盖。
动作显得僵硬

entries.source: Replace abstract verbs such as “moves beautifully” with observable movement: shifts weight to the left foot, turns the shoulders, raises the right hand, then looks toward camera. Add secondary motion only after the main action works.
entries.translation: 将“优雅移动”等抽象词换成可观察动作：重心移到左脚、转动肩膀、抬起右手，再看向镜头。主要动作成功后，再加入次要运动。

entries.source: The camera jumps or ignores direction
entries.translation: 镜头跳动或忽略方向

entries.source: Remove competing moves and describe one continuous path with a start frame and end frame. “Slow dolly in from medium shot to close-up” is more controllable than a list containing zoom, orbit, pan, handheld shake, and crane movement.
entries.translation: 删除竞争性的运镜，描述一条连续路径并给出起始和结束构图。“从中景缓慢推进至特写”比同时列出变焦、环绕、摇镜头、手持晃动和升降镜头更可控。
背景扭曲

entries.source: Use a shorter movement, avoid extreme parallax from a flat source image, and instruct the model to preserve architecture, horizon, straight lines, and spatial layout. A wider source image usually gives the camera more room.
entries.translation: 缩短移动范围，避免用平面来源图制造极端视差，并要求保持建筑、地平线、直线与空间布局。较宽的来源图通常能给镜头更多空间。

entries.source: The clip feels busy or incoherent
entries.translation: 片段过于繁忙或不连贯

entries.source: Reduce the number of subjects, actions, scene changes, and style modifiers. Create the story as separate stable beats, then extend or edit after each beat works.
entries.translation: 减少主体、动作、场景变化和风格修饰词。把故事拆成稳定节点，各节点成功后再延长或编辑。

Seedance 2.5 图生视频检查清单

entries.source: The reference image is sharp and matches the intended framing.
entries.translation: 参考图清晰，并匹配目标构图。

entries.source: The prompt contains one primary action and one primary camera movement.
entries.translation: 提示词包含一个主要动作和一种主要运镜。

entries.source: Every reference asset has one clearly defined role.
entries.translation: 每份参考素材都有明确职责。

entries.source: Time ranges do not contain conflicting actions.
entries.translation: 时间区间不包含冲突动作。

entries.source: Identity, wardrobe, object, and background constraints are explicit.
entries.translation: 身份、服装、物体与背景约束明确。

entries.source: The first draft is short enough to diagnose quickly.
entries.translation: 首个草稿足够短，便于快速分析。

entries.source: Only one variable changes between test generations.
entries.translation: 测试生成之间只改变一个变量。

entries.source: The final review checks the first frame, last frame, hands, face, geometry, motion, and sound.
entries.translation: 最终检查覆盖首尾帧、手、脸、结构、动作和声音。
常见问题

entries.source: and describe the people, setting and style. Or download the reference and use it in another image tool.

entries.source: What should you put in the prompt?
entries.translation: 提示词应该写什么？

entries.source: Let the reference show the arrangement. Use words for the details it cannot show: who the people are, their clothes, the place, the time of day and the mood.
entries.translation: 让参考图展示布局，用文字说明它无法展示的细节：人物身份、服装、地点、时间和氛围。

entries.source: For a busy scene, also state how many people and animals you want. Give each one a simple description, such as “the seated person on the left” or “the cat on the stool.”
entries.translation: 复杂场景还应注明人物和动物数量，并用简单描述区分每个主体，例如“左侧坐着的人”或“凳子上的猫”。

entries.source: A few small choices make a big difference
entries.translation: 几个小选择会产生很大影响

entries.source: Leave a gap between subjects when their arms, legs or tails overlap too much.
entries.translation: 手臂、腿或尾巴重叠太多时，在主体之间留出间隔。

entries.source: Check the view from the camera you will actually use. A good pose can disappear behind a table.
entries.translation: 从实际使用的镜头检查视图，再好的姿势也可能被桌子遮住。

entries.source: Use body and background colors to make your reference easy to read.
entries.translation: 通过身体和背景颜色，让参考图容易辨识。

entries.source: After generation, check the details that matter to you—especially hands, pet count, furniture and the crop. A reference guides the image; it does not lock every detail.
entries.translation: 生成后检查自己重视的细节，尤其是手、宠物数量、家具和裁切。参考用于引导图像，无法锁定每个细节。
关于这些案例

entries.source: The nine new reference-to-image examples use Pose Studio’s current character models, pose presets and props, arranged for this article. The references were rendered from saved scene setups and sent to the site’s image service using developer API credits. Each new example shows its first generated image, without retouching. Ten requests were submitted; one timed out and is not shown as a finished example. The earlier six examples use captures from the previous single-person editor.
entries.translation: 九组全新参考到图像案例使用姿势工作室当前的人物模型、预设与道具，专门为本文编排。参考图从保存的场景渲染，并用开发者 API 积分发送至本站图像服务。每组展示首次生成结果，未经修图。共提交十个请求，其中一个超时，未作为完成案例展示。早期六组案例来自旧单人编辑器的截图。

entries.source: Results vary with the image model and prompt. These examples show possibilities, not a guarantee of exact poses or object placement.
entries.translation: 结果会随图像模型和提示词变化。这些案例展示可能性，无法保证姿势或物体位置完全一致。
